text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: This is our Love Arcadia for two~♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That was so peak! A heavy, fiery,
and somehow deeply serious singing voice.
That's what it was."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Still, how many songs has it been now?
Aren't you singing at a bit too fast a pace?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Gyo, gyoooon-eeeeeeh~!
No way... Wh-wh-what are these numbers...
It's gotta be a mistake... Wait, it isn't!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
This is bad, so bad... If this keeps up, I won't be able to pull off
my favorite skirts or accessories anymore~~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I need to lose weight right now...!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And that's why we're at karaoke♪
I mean, singing tires you out, right?
So let's lose weight by singing~♡ Something like that♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh...
How many songs do you plan to sing before it kicks in...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get all the details,
but either way, give me lots! ♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: How typical of you, or should I say...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I did it, Heart-chan! I lost weight!
The karaoke diet was a huge success~♪

With Daring Heart's help,
she successfully completed
her karaoke diet.
